logistics.format: Two-phase exam: Phase I knowledge-based written exam (~174 questions, ~2 hours), Phase II practical examination (60-day take-home forensic case requiring written report); 3 years validity

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded forensic case and written report, longstanding reputation and law-enforcement recognition support professional examination despite a one-year profile; EnCase dependency limits tool-independent inference.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A practical evidence case and written report after a knowledge exam provide substantial professional forensic-work evidence. Recorded law-enforcement reputation strengthens the signal, while tool lock-in and the one-year profile limit broader seniority conclusions.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded take-home forensic case and written report demonstrate investigative delivery beyond the one-year profile. Longstanding community and law-enforcement recognition support professional placement, while EnCase dependence narrows the signal.
